about: Limb-movement detection: one binary probe per event (any limb movement, periodic limb movement) and threshold, positive when the epoch holds more than that many seconds of it (sleep_limb reports periodic limb movement at 0.5 s).
_doc: Limb-movement detection with the respiratory_event_detection task, a per-field binary event probe driven by event_fields. Thresholds are seconds of limb movement per epoch: the task's default grid plus 0.5 s, the threshold paper v2 reports periodic limb movement at (Fig. 17c; the sleep_limb benchmark's headline).
